about_the_game:
Enter the tale of the forgotten, where whispers of ancient power echo through fractured realms. Your journey begins in the depths of a haunted forest where a mysterious storyteller awaits—the guardian of a fragmented truth that will set you on a perilous quest to piece together The Longest Tale ever told.

Explore The Land of the Shattered Kingdoms

Navigate a world in conflict where three enigmatic civilizations guard the secrets of their broken past. From the ethereal, mist-shrouded forests of the Zeffari, to the merciless sun-scorched expanses of Ilfrau, to the vertigo-inducing architecture of Torrene - outsmart the enemies of each realm to uncover the forbidden truth. With your new knowledge, will you unify the three tribes or exploit their rivalry to claim the power as your own?

Uncover the Ancient Lore

Hunt for clues and piece together fragments of a story older than time…

…Decipher cryptic glyphs etched into abandoned temples…

…Solve reality-warping puzzles that challenge your perception…

…Unearth artifacts that whisper of forgotten power... 

But beware – some secrets were buried for a reason, and the price of enlightenment may be your very soul!

Confront Your Darkest Nightmares Come To Life

Duel with gravity-defying samurai warriors on the edge of life and death… 

...Or evade your enemies as you pursue your target…

…Outmaneuver spectral predators that stalk through twilight forests…

…One misstep means falling into oblivion… 

Game Features

  • Four Heroes: Each level unlocks a new hero, with their own trails and quests that interweaves the forgotten tale together

  • Living, Breathing World: Discover a story embedded in every crumbling ruin and ancient artifact through stunning visuals and a mind-bending experience.

  • Strategic Combat: Master a combat system where precise timing and tactical thinking triumph over brute force.

  • Adaptive Progression: Each decision changes your world, transforming environments and creating new pathways with each playthrough.

  • The Hidden Truth: Only by exploring all possible paths can you unlock the secret of this world—and your true role within it.

Do you dare uncover what lies at the end of The Longest Tale?

short_description: Greetings hero! A world of intrigue and mystery awaits you. Explore, fight, and sneak through the lands of ancient civilizations. Solve mind-bending puzzles and riddles. Piece together the fragmented story lost to time... will you uncover the tale?
